workarounds.symptom: `ruff check --verbose` aborts (SIGABRT) when stderr is a pipe that closes early
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Avoid crashing when Ruff logs to a closed stderr pipe. Target files: crates/ruff/src/lib.rs, crates/ruff_linter/src/logging.rs, crates/ruff/tests/cli/lint.rs. When a pipe reader closes stderr, fern tries to report the failed log write to the same pipe and panics. Ruff now ignores stderr write errors when logging, so linting can finish and report diagnostics on stdout. The panic hook also tolerates write failures when reporting a crash. (Ref: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/pull/30209)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Qwen3.5 GatedDeltaNet: finalize_fused_in_proj builds the fused in_proj weight on CPU under --cpu-offload-gb (mat2 is on cpu)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Fix] qwen3.5: Keep CPU-offloaded GDN input projections separate. Target files: python/sglang/srt/models/qwen3_5.py, test/registered/amd/test_qwen35_gdn_packed_in_proj.py, test/registered/model_loading/test_cpu_offloader.py. With V1 CPU offload, `finalize_fused_in_proj()` can concatenate host-resident GatedDeltaNet projection weights into a plain tensor attribute. The offloader stages registered parameters for each forward, but this fused cache stays on the CPU. The first fused GEMM then fails with `mat2 is on cpu`. (Ref: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47899)
